2. SCOPE OF WORK EXECUTED
Sewerage Drainage works for Subarnarekha Valley Corporation completed 2014.
The work was carried out under site conditions that included restricted access requiring night-time material
movement. The agency organised its resources around this without recourse to the department for additional
assistance, and the programme was re-sequenced locally to keep the critical path intact.
An extension of time was granted during execution on account of a revision to the approved drawings issued
after mobilisation. The delay was examined by this office and held to be beyond the agency's control; no
compensation was claimed and none has been paid.
The above work was executed under the supervision of the undersigned in accordance with the approved
drawings, specifications, and the terms and conditions of the contract. The work has been completed in all
respects and has been got inspected by the Engineer-in-Chief / Superintending Engineer.

3. QUALITY ASSESSMENT
The overall quality of the completed work is graded Excellent. Workmanship was acceptable with minor
rework at two locations, and final inspection was completed in the presence of the client's representative.
Materials were drawn from approved sources and the test results filed with this office were within the limits
prescribed in the contract specification.

5. DEFICIENCY / OBSERVATION LIST
At the time of taking over, minor honeycombing on one abutment face, since made good. Regarding site safety,
the site maintained its safety induction register without lapse. The agency's conduct during the contract is
recorded as prompt and well documented.
Nil. No major deficiencies observed during the final inspection carried out on 2014-09-14. All minor
observations pointed out during the interim inspections have been rectified to the satisfaction of the inspecting
authority.
6. RECOMMENDATION
Having satisfied myself as to the quantity and quality of the work executed, and on the basis of the joint
measurements recorded in the measurement book, I certify the work complete and recommend release of the
balance payment together with the retention money due on expiry of the defect liability period. Certified by B.
Bhattacharya, Project Director.
The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and contract
conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried out by the
undersigned.
